title: DraftAttention: Fast Video Diffusion via Low-Resolution Attention Guidance

baseline_method.description: Full dense attention in video diffusion transformers
baseline_method.example: For 768p video with 128 frames: n ≈ 500K tokens, d = 1024 → [500K, 500K, 1K] operations

improved_method.description: Adaptive DraftAttention with learned sparsity and quantization
improved_method.computation: [n/k, n/k, d/4] + [n, n, d/4] * s + communication_overhead

breakdown.quantized_sparse: [n, n, d/4] * s where s ∈ [0.05, 0.2] learned

gaps_limitations.gap: Fixed pooling kernel size (8×16) regardless of content or resolution
gaps_limitations.impact: Suboptimal for varying video content and resolutions
gaps_limitations.improvement: Adaptive pooling with learned kernel sizes per layer

gaps_limitations.gap: Static sparsity ratio (fixed percentage) throughout generation
gaps_limitations.impact: May discard important information in critical denoising steps
gaps_limitations.improvement: Dynamic sparsity scheduling based on timestep and content

gaps_limitations.gap: No quantization integration despite orthogonal benefits
gaps_limitations.improvement: INT4/INT8 quantization for attention weights and activations

gaps_limitations.gap: First 25% steps require full attention for quality
gaps_limitations.improvement: Progressive sparsity with learned importance scores

gaps_limitations.impact: Cannot handle very long videos (>1000 frames)

gaps_limitations.gap: No temporal consistency enforcement in sparsity patterns
gaps_limitations.impact: Potential flickering artifacts in generated videos
gaps_limitations.improvement: Temporal smoothing of sparsity masks across frames

innovative_improvements.name: Adaptive Kernel DraftAttention
innovative_improvements.description: Learn optimal pooling kernel sizes per layer based on content characteristics
innovative_improvements.technical_details: Use lightweight MLP to predict kernel size k ∈ {4,8,16,32} for each spatial region
innovative_improvements.runtime_change: [n/k, n/k, d] where k is adaptive instead of fixed 128

innovative_improvements.name: Dynamic Sparsity Scheduler
innovative_improvements.description: Adjust sparsity ratio based on denoising timestep and content complexity
innovative_improvements.technical_details: Learn timestep-dependent sparsity function s(t) = σ(α·t + β·content_complexity)
innovative_improvements.runtime_change: [n, n, d] * s(t) instead of fixed ratio r

innovative_improvements.name: Quantized DraftAttention
innovative_improvements.description: Integrate INT4 quantization for draft attention computation
innovative_improvements.technical_details: Apply Q-diffusion techniques to draft attention weights and activations
innovative_improvements.runtime_change: [n/k, n/k, d/4] with INT4 precision + dequantization overhead

innovative_improvements.name: Progressive Sparsity Learning
innovative_improvements.description: Learn importance scores to enable sparsity from step 1
innovative_improvements.technical_details: Train lightweight adapter to predict token importance without full attention

innovative_improvements.name: Distributed DraftAttention
innovative_improvements.description: Split video across GPUs with overlapping regions for consistency
innovative_improvements.technical_details: Use ring-reduce communication for draft attention across distributed nodes
innovative_improvements.runtime_change: [n/p, n, d] + [n, n/p, d] + [n, d, 1] communication per step

innovative_improvements.name: Temporal Consistency Sparsity
innovative_improvements.description: Enforce smooth sparsity patterns across temporal dimension
innovative_improvements.technical_details: Apply 3D convolutional smoothing on sparsity masks before application
innovative_improvements.runtime_change: [n, n, d] + [t, h, w, 1] smoothing kernel overhead
